types.title: Supplier document types
types.intro: The documents suppliers send through the portal. Required types must be there before an application is sent and before it goes for approval. Close a type you no longer use instead of deleting it.
types.codeHint: Capitals, digits and underscores, e.g. COMPANY_CERT. An existing code changes that type
types.validityHint: Leave empty to use the expiry printed on the document
types.sensitive: Sensitive (every opening of the file is logged)

documents.title: Supplier documents
documents.empty: This supplier has no document yet
documents.sensitiveNote: Sensitive document: opening the file is logged
documents.file: File (PDF, JPG, PNG or WebP, at most 20 MB)
documents.expiresOn: Expiry printed on the document (if any)
documents.uploaded: Sent. The file is being scanned, then procurement will check it
documents.idCardHint: ID card: please cover the religion field before you photograph or scan it
